title: TrackGraph in Entity Framework Core
description: Learn to track entity graphs and set custom EntityState for each entity.

data.text: The `ChangeTracker.TrackGraph()` method tracks the entire entity graph and allows setting custom EntityState for each entity.

data.title: TrackGraph Example
data.content: Using TrackGraph to set custom EntityState

data.caption: TrackGraph callback flow
data.definition:
graph TB
    A[Root Entity] --> B[TrackGraph Callback]
    B --> C{IsKeySet?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Set Unchanged]
    C -->|No| E[Set Added]
    D --> F[Next Entity]
    E --> F

data.title: IsKeySet Property
data.text: Use `IsKeySet` to determine if an entity has a valid key value. This helps distinguish new entities from existing ones.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Callback function called for each entity
IsKeySet determines new vs existing entities
data.takeaway: Continue to the next module to learn about querying.
